key.name: notifications-collapse
key.description: Hide notifications behind a toggle button on the lock screen

key.name: unblank-enabled
key.description: Prevent the lock screen from dimming or blanking the display

key.name: unblank-ac-only
key.description: Only keep the screen unblanked when plugged in to AC power

key.name: unblank-timeout
key.description: Re-allow blanking after this many minutes. 0 means never re-blank.

key.name: blur-enabled
key.description: Apply a blur effect to the lock screen wallpaper

key.name: blur-sigma
key.description: Gaussian blur sigma value. Higher values create more blur.

key.name: brightness-enabled
key.description: Apply a dark overlay on the lock screen background

key.name: message-enabled
key.description: Display a custom text message on the lock screen

key.name: message-text
key.description: The text to display on the lock screen

key.name: message-size
key.description: Font size of the custom message in pixels

key.name: message-color
key.description: Hex color of the custom message text
